{{Top|fa}} {{Otheruses|Mika|more=Gray}} {{Character |type= |image=[[File:MikaGrey-TheRelicRaiders.jpg]] |name=Mika Grey |homeworld= |birth= |death= |species=[[Human]]{{Resistance|The Relic Raiders}} |gender=[[Gender|Female]] |pronouns=She/her{{Resistance|Kaz's Curse}} |height= |mass= |hair=[[Color|White]] |feathers= |eyes=Green |skin=Tan |cyber= |families= |parents= |partners= |siblings= |children= |affiliation=[[Team Colossus|Team ''Colossus'']]{{Resistance|The Escape (episode)}} |masters= |apprentices= }} {{Quote|The Force doesn't belong to any ''one'' person. It is something that is inside ''all'' of us. We just find it in different ways.|Mika Grey, to Eila|audio=MikaGrey1-TheRelicRaiders.mp3|}} '''Mika Grey''' was a [[Force-sensitive]] [[human]] [[Gender|female]] [[archaeologist]]. Around [[31 ABY]], she began [[Mika Grey's hunt for relics|scouring]] [[the galaxy]] for [[Sith artifact]]s, hoping to acquire them before the [[First Order]] could. The archaeologist traveled to the celestial body [[Vargos 9]] nearly [[33 ABY|two years]] afterward and encountered a [[Raith's squad|squad]] of [[First Order Raider]]s who were also searching for [[dark side artifact]]s. Following her departure, the [[squad]] continued to track Grey's travels. In [[34 ABY]], Grey visited the [[planet]] [[Ashas Ree]] and excavated a [[Ashas Ree Sith temple|Sith temple]] there. After successfully raising the [[Sith temple]], the [[Treasure hunting|treasure hunter]] attempted to take a [[Unidentified Sith relic|Sith relic]] from the site, only to accidentally activate a trap that imprisoned her in a chamber below. Nearly two [[Standard day|days]] later, the [[Resistance]] [[spy]] [[Kazuda Xiono]], the [[Kel and Eila's family|siblings]] [[Kel]] and [[Eila]], and the [[BB-series astromech droid|astromech droid]] [[CB-23]] heard Grey's pleas for help and [[Mission to Ashas Ree|entered]] the temple to assist her. After attempting to touch the [[Sith]] [[Force artifact|relic]], Xiono, too, fell into Grey's chamber. Kel, Eila, and CB-23 helped the two escape their predicament by pressing on [[Unidentified ancient script|Sith hieroglyphics]] before the structure's mechanisms could crush the pair. Grey then stowed the Sith relic in her [[backpack]]. Afterward, when Xiono accidentally activated the Sith temple's [[Self-destruct mechanism|self-destruction sequence]], Grey fled the crumbling temple with her newfound acquaintances. First Order Raiders, who had tracked Grey to the world, met them outside, eventually capturing most of the group. The archaeologist then activated the Sith relic, and its detonation [[Death|killed]] the [[trooper]]s. Grey subsequently accepted Kel and Eila's offer to join them aboard the [[Trantor-class supertanker fuel depot|supertanker fuel depot]] ''[[Colossus]]''. Grey began working as a [[fortune teller]] and [[prophet]] on the ''Colossus'' in the [[Supertanker fuel depot|platform's]] [[Colossus marketplace|marketplace]]. When the [[Warbird gang|Warbird]] [[pirate]] [[Leoz]] [[Aka Du|cursed]] Xiono, the latter consulted Grey for assistance in removing the supposed affliction. The fortune teller gave him a [[wood]]en [[Kaz's talisman|talisman]] to ward off the curse's effects, telling him that they only extended to how much he believed in it. Emboldened by her words, Xiono overcame his fears concerning the curse and successfully helped the ''Colossus''{{'s}} [[Ace Squadron]] [[Skirmish in Guavian Death Space|protect]] the [[Supertanker fuel depot|platform]] against the [[Guavian Death Gang]]. Later that [[Standard year|year]], Grey [[Team Colossus|helped]] defend the ''Colossus'' when the First Order [[Resurgent-class Star Destroyer|Star Destroyer]] ''[[Thunderer]]'' [[Battle of Barabesh|attacked]] the [[Space station|platform]] in the [[Barabesh system]]. ==Biography== ===Relic hunting=== {{Quote|So how long you been trapped down here, exactly?''"
"''Almost two days. The villagers fled after I excavated the temple. They thought evil forces would be unleashed. Superstitious fools.|Kazuda Xiono and Mika Grey|audio=MikaGrey2-TheRelicRaiders.mp3|}} [[File:AshasReeTemple-TheRelicRaiders.jpg|thumb|left|300px|Mika Grey excavated a Sith temple (pictured) on Ashas Ree while searching for dark side artifacts.]] The [[human]] [[Gender|female]] Mika Grey was a [[Force-sensitive]]{{SW|url=news/buckets-list-extra-the-relic-raider-star-wars-resistance|text=Bucket's List Extra: 7 Fun Facts from "The Relic Raider" - ''Star Wars Resistance''|date=2019-11-18}} [[archaeologist]] and [[Treasure hunting|treasure hunter]] who lived during the [[New Republic Era|reign]] of the [[New Republic]].''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' At some point during her travels, she acquired a [[wood]]en [[Kaz's talisman|talisman]]. Around [[31 ABY]], Grey began [[Mika Grey's hunt for relics|searching]] for [[Sith artifact]]s across [[the galaxy]] in an effort to keep the [[Force artifact|relics]] out of the hands of the [[First Order]], particularly its eventual [[Supreme Leader]], [[Ben Solo|Kylo Ren]].{{Databank|mika-grey|Mika Grey}} Nearly [[33 ABY|two years later]], Grey first encountered a [[Raith's squad|squad]] of [[First Order Raider]]s—elite First Order [[trooper]]s hunting for [[Dark side artifact|dark side relics]]—while on the terrestrial astronomical object [[Vargos 9]]. She eventually traveled off the celestial body and believed she had eluded her pursuers. Unbeknownst to Grey, the First Order Raiders continued tracking her whereabouts. In [[34 ABY]],{{ResistanceDate|2|7}} Grey embarked on a new hunt for an [[Unidentified Sith relic|ancient Sith relic]] she considered dangerous due to its destructive potential to [[Death|kill]] all life in its path.{{Databank|sith-relic|Sith Relic}} Having been searching for it for two and a half [[Standard year|years]], she traveled to the [[forest]]ed [[Outer Rim Territories|Outer Rim]] [[planet]] [[Ashas Ree]]. After landing her [[Mika Grey's ship|starship]] on the outskirts of the planet's [[Ashas Ree outpost|trading outpost]], she entered the settlement, finding it to be adjacent to a [[Ashas Ree Temple of the Force|Temple of the Force]] that had in turn been built atop an ancient [[Ashas Ree Sith temple|Sith temple]]. When the treasure hunter began excavating the [[Sith temple]] to raise its shrine upward, her efforts terrified the [[Homeworld|local]] villagers. Sensing the ripples of destructive [[Dark side of the Force|dark side]] power emanating from the nearby structure,{{Databank|ashas-ree|Ashas Ree}} the locals fled into Ashas Ree's forests, leaving hastily scrawled warnings in their outpost to ward away travelers. The treasure hunter's excavation efforts proved successful, and she broke inside the structure. ===Trapped in a temple=== {{Quote|No. No! No, no. Wait. Hold on. Don't come any closer!''"
"''Who are you? What are you doing here?|Kazuda Xiono and Mika Grey|audio=MikaGrey3-TheRelicRaiders.mp3|}} [[File:XionoMeetsMikaGrey-TheRelicRaiders.jpg|thumb|right|300px|Mika Grey threatened Kazuda Xiono upon their first meeting in order to determine whether he was working for the First Order.]] While attempting to retrieve the relic from the temple's dusty crypt, Grey set off one of the totem's many traps and puzzles and became trapped in a chamber below the artifact's altar.{{SW|url=the-relic-raider-episode-gallery|text="The Relic Raider" Episode Gallery}} {{C|Slide 4}} She began pleading for help, remaining trapped in the chamber for almost two [[Standard day|days]]. Eventually, the [[Kel and Eila's family|siblings]] [[Kel]] and [[Eila]], the [[Resistance]] [[spy]] [[Kazuda Xiono]], and the [[BB-series astromech droid|astromech droid]] [[CB-23]] heard her cries when they [[Mission to Ashas Ree|entered]] the temple, and they followed the sound of her voice to try to help her. After the group became separated in the temple, Xiono and CB-23 entered the room holding the artifact Grey had been seeking, and the spy reached out to touch it while suffering disorientation from an electric shock trap. When Xiono's [[Limb|hand]] neared the object, despite Grey's warning to stay away, he set off one of the temple's traps and fell into the chamber housing the archaeologist. After Xiono sent CB-23 away to bring Kel and Eila to help, Grey approached the spy and admonished him for trying to touch the artifact. The archaeologist's appearance scared the Resistance operative, and he backed away from her, eventually tripping and falling on his back. Grey picked up Xiono by his [[jacket]] and demanded to know his intentions, only releasing him after ascertaining that he was not working for the First Order. The treasure hunter then expounded on how she had excavated the temple and eventually became trapped inside. Grey continued to answer Xiono's questions, explaining how the planet's villagers had fled when she began her work on the world. Despite Grey's warnings for him to stay still, Xiono accidentally triggered a booby-trap device that activated a giant [[drill]]-like{{SW|url=the-relic-raider-episode-gallery|text="The Relic Raider" Episode Gallery}} {{C|Slide 8}} machine below them. [[File:XionoGreyGrinder-TheRelicRaiders.jpg|thumb|left|300px|Mika Grey and Kazuda Xiono in a Sith temple trap]] Xiono and Grey were then thrown against the chamber's walls when they began to spin, with the resultant force immobilizing them. Eila, Kel, and CB-23 arrived as the trap's grinder moved closer to the pair, and with Grey's guidance, the two siblings pressed the two [[star]]-shaped [[Unidentified ancient script|Sith hieroglyphics]] that deactivated it. Although CB-23 let down a grappling cable for Xiono to help him out of the chamber, Grey leaped out of the pit on her own. She then retrieved the relic and stored it in her [[backpack]], informing the others present that she intended to take it in order to keep it out of others' possession. Shortly afterward, Xiono pressed one of the temple's wall symbols and activated the structure's [[Self-destruct mechanism|self-destruction sequence]]. The group rushed out of the crumbling temple together, narrowly escaping up several flights of stairs. ===Destruction of a relic=== {{Quote|Took you long enough to catch up with me!''"
"''Hand over the relic. Now!''"
"''Oh! You mean this? I know your precious Supreme Leader won't be pleased when you come back empty-handed.|Mika Grey and Raith|audio=MikaGrey4-TheRelicRaiders.mp3|}} [[File:MikaGreySithRelicActivation-TheRelicRaiders.jpg|thumb|right|300px|Mika Grey activated a Sith relic, using its destructive capabilities to destroy First Order Raiders.]] Upon reaching the temple's exit, the group found that First Order Raiders led by the [[First Order stormtrooper|stormtrooper]] [[Raith]] had arrived on the world searching for Grey. When Grey saw that the [[squad]] had captured Xiono's colleagues—the [[pilot]]s [[Torra Doza]] and [[Freya Fenris]]—she suggested returning to her [[Starship|ship]] to flee the confrontation. However, the First Order destroyed her vessel moments later, leading Xiono to propose an alternate plan of rescuing his friends. Before they could do so, Grey left, and Xiono, Kel, Eila, and CB-23 were captured by the First Order Raiders and held in custody alongside Doza and Fenris. Meanwhile, Grey climbed onto the temple's roof and taunted the troopers by brandishing the [[Sith]] relic she had acquired. When Raith demanded she surrender the artifact, she instead activated the relic and threw it toward the troopers and their captives, warning Xiono and his companions to flee into the temple. Moments afterward, the Sith relic unleashed waves of destructive energy,{{SW|url=the-relic-raider-episode-gallery|text="The Relic Raider" Episode Gallery}} {{C|Slide 11}} killing the First Order Raiders who had attempted to deactivate it. [[File:MikaGreyDrainedRelic-TheRelicRaiders.png|thumb|left|300px|After the First Order Raiders were killed by the relic's power, Mika Grey held the now-drained artifact in disdain.]] After eliminating the First Order threat, Grey briefly bemoaned the destruction of the now-useless relic, as she had been searching for it for a long [[time]]. She then told Xiono and his companions that she needed to find a way off Ashas Ree since the First Order had destroyed her ship. Kaz and Eila invited Grey to join them aboard the ''[[Colossus]]''—a [[Trantor-class supertanker fuel depot|supertanker fuel depot]] fleeing the First Order. Accepting the invitation, Grey conversed with Eila during their journey to the ''Colossus'' and told the young girl about [[the Force]] and about her own identity as neither a [[Jedi]] nor a Sith. As the archaeologist expounded on her perspective on the qualities of the Force, Xiono listened intently.{{SW|url=the-relic-raider-episode-gallery|text="The Relic Raider" Episode Gallery}} {{C|Slide 12}} ===Fortune teller=== {{Quote|Aka Du… Hmm…''"
"''You have heard of it?''"
"''I've heard of many things. A large part of a curse will come down to how much you believe in it or not. And from what it seems, you believe in it more than you are letting on. Have you ever had a lucky charm?|Mika Grey and Kazuda Xiono|audio=MikaGrey-KazsCurse.mp3|}} [[File:MikaGreyWatchingMarketplace-KazsCurse.jpg|thumb|right|300px|Mika Grey learned of Kazuda Xiono's curse issue on the ''Colossus''.]] Later that year,{{ResistanceDate|2|10}} Grey began working as a [[fortune teller]] and [[prophet]] in the ''Colossus''{{'s}} [[Colossus marketplace|marketplace]], where she operated a [[Mika's tent|stall]] and charged each customer fifty [[Galactic Credit Standard|credits]] for her services. The [[gorg]] [[Gorgmonger|merchant]] [[Bolza Grool]] became one of her clients and wished to know if he would survive the ongoing [[First Order-Resistance War|war]] in the [[galaxy]]. When Grey predicted that his future included tiny [[Tooth|teeth]] gnawing on his insides, Grool interpreted it to mean that he was in danger from his gorgs. Despite the [[Klatooinian]]'s offers to [[Currency|pay]] her an additional fee for more details about his future, she declined and collected payment from him. After the [[Warbird gang|Warbird]] [[pirate]] [[Leoz]] cast a supposed [[Aka Du|curse]] on Xiono, Grey became aware of his predicament and watched the pilot and his colleague, the [[Technician|mechanic]] [[Neeku Vozo]], from her marketplace stall. Later, the Resistance operative visited her in order to remove the curse after Vozo had convinced him he needed her help. The fortune teller slowly eased Xiono's [[boot]] full of credits toward herself, tucking them closer to her as she counseled him that the effects of any curse largely depended on how much one believed in it. She gave Kaz a small wooden talisman to ward off bad luck and evil energies, explaining that she had acquired it on her travels. [[File:MikaGreyKazudaXiono-KazsCurse.png|thumb|left|300px|Kazuda Xiono asked Mika Grey for help in her marketplace tent.]] When the ''Colossus''{{'s}} [[Alarm system|alarms]] began blaring due to a [[Guavian Death Gang]] [[Skirmish in Guavian Death Space|attack]], Xiono hastily left Grey's company and took the charm with him. Shortly afterward, Xiono accidentally dropped the talisman in a [[hangar]] prior to boarding his [[Racing starfighter|racer]], the ''[[Fireball]]''. After leading the [[Supertanker fuel depot|platform's]] [[Ace Squadron]] to victory against the Guavians, the pilot learned from Vozo that he had dropped the charm before leaving the ''Colossus'' and realized Leoz had never cursed him. Recalling Grey's earlier advice, Xiono decided to give Grey's totem to the pirate and claimed that it was cursed, which made the pirate panic due to his superstitious beliefs. Xiono later thanked Grey for helping him, and, after he left, the amused fortune teller reflected on how superstitious the pirates on the ''Colossus'' were. ===Fighting the First Order=== {{Quote|Earlier today, Kazuda Xiono and Jarek Yeager went to try and rescue one of our own, Tam Ryvora. We haven't heard from them since. ''[…]'' I am asking you to help our friends.|Imanuel Doza, to Mika Grey and the ''Colossus''{{'s}} other residents|audio=DozaImplores-TheEscape.mp3|}} [[File:ColossusDefenders-TheEscape.png|thumb|right|300px|Mika Grey and other ''Colossus'' residents defend their platform.]] When the First Order [[Resurgent-class Star Destroyer|Star Destroyer]] ''[[Thunderer]]'' pursued the ''Colossus'' to the [[Barabesh system]] in 34 [['ABY-BBY' dating system|ABY]], [[Captain]] [[Imanuel Doza]] gathered the [[Space station|platform's]] residents, including Grey, in the [[cantina]] [[Aunt Z's Tavern]]. He pleaded with those present to help [[Battle of Barabesh|rescue]] a trio of ''Colossus'' residents—Xiono, the mechanic [[Jarek Yeager]], and the [[First Order TIE fighter pilot|TIE pilot]] [[Tamara Ryvora]]—who were trapped onboard the ''Thunderer''. After Xiono and Ryvora sent a [[Hologram|holographic]] transmission broadcasted to those in the cantina begging them to flee before the First Order arrived, Grey and the others on the ''Colossus'' felt moved by their loyalty and decided to help them. The fortune teller and several [[Team Colossus|others]] prepared to engage with a boarding party in one of the ''Colossus''{{'s}} marketplaces, and when the troopers arrived, she fired her [[blaster pistol]] at them before retreating alongside her colleagues behind a door. However, the First Order's stormtroopers pursued Grey and the station resident [[Jooks]] down a corridor. As the pair fled, Grool jumped in the pursuers' path to slow their pace and attacked them. Shortly afterward, pilots from the Ace and [[Jade Squadron]]s destroyed the ''Thunderer''{{'s}} [[engine]]s, causing the vessel to explode and marking the ''Colossus''{{'s}} success in the entanglement. Grey celebrated their victory alongside the platform's other residents. ==Personality and traits== {{Quote|I've been looking for this relic for two and a half years. I finally find it…and end up destroying it. Do you know what the lesson is here?''"
"''Uh… be careful what you find in old temples?''"
"''No. Be careful ''who'' you find in old temples, because they can ruin your day.|Mika Grey and Kazuda Xiono|audio=MikaGrey5-TheRelicRaiders.mp3|}} Grey was a woman with [[Color|tan]] skin, white [[hair]], and green [[eye]]s. She sported blue [[tattoo]]s on her face and arms. By the time of her visit to Ashas Ree in 34 ABY, she possessed a well-muscled physique and was capable of executing leaps and running from First Order pursuers. Grey also had an aged appearance by that time, evidenced by a few wrinkles on her face. The archaeologist was a fearless individual willing to seek out dangerous Sith artifacts to keep them out of the hands of the First Order. Although she was pursued by First Order Raiders, Grey proved inventive in eluding them as she traveled the galaxy. The rugged archaeologist preferred to work alone, trusting in her own abilities to lead her to success. Despite the alluring power offered by the Sith relics she hunted, she cared little for the monetary benefit of turning them over to the First Order. Although she was neither a Jedi nor a Sith, Grey cared about the Force and held the opinion that it belonged to everyone instead of any specific person. Grey did not believe in curses being real and thought that their effect only reached as far as the cursed individual's belief in them. The archaeologist regarded the villagers on Ashas Ree as superstitious fools for fleeing after her excavation of the world's Sith temple. [[File:MikaGreyBolzaGrool-KazsCurse.png|thumb|left|300px|As a fortune teller, Mika Grey served clients such as Bolza Grool.]] Upon first meeting Kazuda Xiono, Grey was wary of the possibility of him working for the First Order and expressed her distrust of him. Her fierce, formidable{{SW|url=news/10-essential-episodes-of-star-wars-resistance|text=10 Essential Episodes of ''Star Wars Resistance'' to Watch on Disney+|author=[[Kristin Baver]]|date=2020-02-25}} presence scared the pilot, and he worried that she would hurt him. However, after Grey determined he was not a threat, the treasure hunter merely found the Resistance spy's clumsiness annoying and disliked how chatty he was. Rather than allow First Order Raiders to take a Sith relic from her, she chose to render it useless by activating it in order to kill the troopers. She enjoyed taunting the First Order Raiders prior to their deaths, taking pride in her evasion of them up until that point. While working as a fortune teller on the ''Colossus'', Grey capitalized on the superstitious fears of her customers by offering advice for a fee of credits. Grey helped counsel Xiono on his fears that a pirate curse was affecting him, offering him a talisman in exchange for his credits to ward off evil. Later, when he realized he had never been cursed, he thanked the fortune teller for her help in overcoming his fears. When the First Order attacked the ''Colossus'', Grey helped defend the station against the invading troopers and worked alongside other residents to repel the [[soldier]]s. ==Powers and abilities== {{Quote|But ultimately, you'll find these things always rise to the surface, and that's what I did. I raised this temple to break inside.|Mika Grey to Kazuda Xiono, about Ashas Ree's Sith temple|audio=MikaGrey6-TheRelicRaiders.mp3|}} [[File:MikaGreySithRelic-TheRelicRaiders.png|thumb|right|300px|Mika Grey collecting a Sith relic]] By the time of the New Republic, Grey had experience as an archaeologist and treasure hunter, allowing her to explore worlds with ancient and dark histories. She was especially knowledgeable about dark side artifacts, including Sith relics and the sacred temples they resided in. The archaeologist was Force-sensitive, which allowed her to sense and seek out sites emanating the power of the Force, such as Ashas Ree's temple.{{Databank|ashas-ree-temple-of-the-force|Ashas Ree Temple of the Force}} Her skills helped her excavate the world's Sith temple, raise it, and break into it in order to locate an artifact. Grey's dark side knowledge helped save her from perishing in the temple, with her proving able to guide Kel and Eila into deactivating one of the temple's traps via interacting with Sith [[Writing|hieroglyphics]]. The treasure hunter was also able to activate and drain the power from a Sith artifact,''[[Star Wars: The Dark Side Pocket Expert]]'' which killed the First Order Raiders threatening her and her companions. As a fortune teller on the ''Colossus'', Grey proved skillful at manipulating people's fears and desires regarding their superstitious beliefs. By charging credits for her services to act as a prophet, she profited from ''Colossus'' residents seeking advice or solutions. ==Equipment== {{Quote|Follow me. My ship is on the other side of the outpost.''"
"''I don't see how that's gonna help my friends. You'd be lucky if they haven't found your ship by now.''"
[Booming noises sound as First Order Raiders destroy Grey's starship]
"''Oh.''"
"''So, um, was that your ship?|Mika Grey and Kazuda Xiono as First Order Raiders destroyed her ship|audio=MikasShip-TheRelicRaiders.flac|}} [[File:MikaGreyTalisman-KazsCurse.jpg|thumb|left|300px|Mika Grey holding a talisman]] While hunting for Sith relics, Grey owned a starship she used to planet-hop across the galaxy. However, First Order Raiders destroyed the vessel on Ashas Ree. While working as a fortune teller in the ''Colossus''{{'s}} marketplace, Grey charged her customers fifty credits for her services and stored her payments near her workspace. At some point, she acquired a talisman that she later gave to Xiono aboard the ''Colossus'', though he gave it to Leoz shortly afterward. During the platform's fight against the First Order in the Barabesh [[Star system|system]], the fortune teller used a [[blaster]] [[pistol]] to fire at stormtroopers. Grey wore a multicolored [[Clothing|shirt]] trimmed in gold, gray pants, and white wrappings around her lower calves. She also put on a gray [[scarf]], gray shoes with white soles, and a gold [[ring]], and styled her hair with decorative clips and a brown hair tie. As part of her outfit, she sported a [[coral]]-colored anklet on one leg, several black ties on the other, gray earrings, and a gold [[nose]] [[piercing]]. Grey donned a brown side pouch attached to a [[belt]] and a light gray backpack that she used to carry the Sith relic on Ashas Ree and to hold her possessions on the ''Colossus''. To complete her ensemble, the treasure hunter wore two armbands—one white and one gold—and donned several beaded [[bracelet]]s in brown, coral, and white. ==Behind the scenes== ===Development=== {{Quote|The talisman was said, at one point, to be something Mika discovered on Mimban. Another iteration of the story had it be a toy doll that Eila was missing. Its true origins remain a mystery…|The ''[[Bucket's List]]'' installment for "Kaz's Curse"|{{SW|url=news/buckets-list-extra-kazs-curse-star-wars-resistance|text=Bucket's List Extra: 4 Fun Facts from "Kaz's Curse" - ''Star Wars Resistance''|date=2019-12-09}}}} [[File:MikaGrey-ConceptArt.jpg|thumb|right|260px|Concept design of Mika Grey by JP Balmet]] Mika Grey first appeared in "[[The Relic Raiders]]," the seventh episode of the [[Star Wars Resistance Season Two|second season]] of the animated television series ''[[Star Wars Resistance]]''. Prior to the episode's release on [[November 17]], [[2019]],{{DisneyPress|wdtv=1|url=disneychannel/shows/star-wars-resistance/episodes|text=Star Wars Resistance}} Grey appeared unnamed in a season trailer released on [[August 14]] of the same year.{{SWYouTube|JkJtdJKCVto|Star Wars Resistance Season 2 - Trailer (Official)|sw_url=video/disneyxd-season-2-trailer-star-wars-resistance|date=2019-08-14}} She was identified by name in "The Relic Raiders" and was voiced by the actor [[Tudi Roche]]. [[Lucasfilm Animation]] artist [[JP Balmet]] made a concept illustration of the character on [[March 10]], [[2018]].{{SW|url=the-relic-raider-concept-art-gallery|text="The Relic Raider" Concept Art Gallery}} {{C|Slide 8}} In an earlier version of the script for "The Relic Raiders," Grey would have elaborated that the Sith relic she acquired on Ashas Ree once belonged to an ancient [[Sith Lord]]. Concept design of a destroyed [[droid]] titled "droidMikaDmg" was created by Lucasfilm Animation artist [[Aaron Pham]] on [[May 17]], 2018.{{SW|url=the-relic-raider-concept-art-gallery|text="The Relic Raider" Concept Art Gallery}} {{C|Slide 11}} Grey also appeared in "[[Kaz's Curse]]," the tenth episode of ''Star Wars Resistance''{{'s}} second season that aired on [[December 8]], 2019. One early version of the episode's story involved the curse inflicted on Kazuda Xiono being real and Grey letting him believe it was merely a superstition in order to make it easier for her to remove. A [[StarWars.com]] article indicated that the talisman in "Kaz's Curse" had several possible origin stories, one of which was that Grey had discovered the trinket on the planet''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia: The Comprehensive Guide to the Star Wars Galaxy]]'' [[Mimban]], while another possible background story was that it was one of Eila's missing [[doll]]s. [[Eugene Son]], the writer for "Kaz's Curse," indicated that there were a lot of different ideas discussed during the development of the episode, as the series' showrunner [[Brandon Auman]] had several ideas of what her character could be. While the ideas of her being a [[Wikipedia:Charlatan|charlatan]] and having Force powers were discussed, Son noted that they ultimately decided to remain vague with Grey's character to leave future storytelling options open. Originally, the scene in which Grey advises Grool about his fate involved teeth gnawing at him was immediately followed by his encounter with a gorg, having been included as a joke. However, Auman ultimately shifted Grool's encounter with a gorg to the end of the episode, separating it from his initial meeting with Grey. Son noted that it was one of his favorite moments of that installment.{{WookYouTube|YGQ--m-MBIg|Wookieepedia Interviews - Eugene Son}} ===Characterization=== {{Quote|The character of Mika Grey evolved from imagining what Asajj Ventress would be like had she survived into this era.|Pablo Hidalgo|}} [[File:Asajj_Ventress_yellow_lightsaber.png|thumb|right|200px|Asajj Ventess (pictured) was the inspiration for the character of Mika Grey.]] According to the [[Lucasfilm Story Group]]'s [[Pablo Hidalgo]], Grey's character was inspired by imagining what [[Asajj Ventress]]—a member of the [[Nightsisters|Nightsister]] [[Dathomiri clan|coven]] of [[witch]]es from the Outer Rim planet [[Dathomir]], who had previously served as a Jedi [[Padawan]] and later as a [[Sith apprentice]] before becoming a [[bounty hunter]]—would have been like had she survived into the episode's time period. The character's name, according to Hidalgo, was a "sort of rhyming nod" to [[Nika Futterman]],{{Twitter|pabl0hidalgo|status/1441592512825606148|[[Pablo Hidalgo]]|date=2021-09-25|quote=There was talk about a Ventress-like character, but not literally Ventress. That became Mika Grey. Her name is a sort of rhyming nod to Nika Futterman.|archivedate=20230624161456}} who voiced Ventress in the animated television series ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]''.{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-clone-wars-stories-of-light-and-dark-audiobook-cast-revealed-exclusive|text=''Star Wars: The Clone Wars - Stories of Light and Dark'' Audiobook Cast Revealed - Exclusive|date=2020-08-10}} Auman indicated that a very early version of the story for "The Relic Raiders" was written to include an older Ventress's [[Duel on the Colossus|confrontation]] with Kylo Ren aboard the ''Colossus''.{{WookYouTube|ML1nYpSU0d0|Wookieepedia Interviews - Brandon Auman}} The script, however, was eventually rewritten to replace Ventress with Grey, as the show's creator [[Dave Filoni]] felt that fans would focus too heavily on Ventress's appearance due to her popularity as a character from ''The Clone Wars'', taking focus away from the series' other characters. During production of the series, Filoni informed Auman that Grey was an ex-Nightsister. Author [[Kristin Baver]] considered the archaeologist similar to Kanata in that Grey did not actively use the Force despite retaining a deep knowledge of and respect for it. ==="The Lost Book"=== {{Quote|…we explored a Mika Grey episode, so we got more of her backstory. It was focused on her.|Brandon Auman, about "The Lost Book"|audio=MikaGrey-BrandonAuman.mp3|{{WookYouTube|ML1nYpSU0d0|Wookieepedia Interviews - Brandon Auman}}}} [[File:MazKanada-SWI207.png|thumb|left|200px|Maz Kanata (pictured) was set to appear in "The Lost Book," working alongside Mika Grey.]] The character was set to feature in another episode, "[[The Lost Book]]," in ''Star Wars Resistance''{{'s}} second season, which was written by [[Steven Melching]]. The episode would have taken place near the end of the season, though set before the finale and penultimate episodes. "The Lost Book" was later cut at some point after its second draft was completed{{WookYouTube|_aRy5PWaiPY|Wookieepedia Interviews - Steven Melching (Part 1)}} due to budgetary constraints. It would have established that she was old friends with{{YouTube|channel=@FriendsOfTheForce|link=Friends of the Force|video=iyB_0nfiD3Q|text=Interview with Brandon Auman - Executive Producer & Head Writer on "Star Wars Resistance"|date=2021-08-29}} the Force-sensitive [[Pirate King|smuggler queen]]{{Databank|maz-kanata|Maz Kanata}} [[Maz Kanata]], having worked together as pirates in the past. The episode, set in 34 ABY,{{ResistanceDate|TheLostBook}} would have included Kanata seeking Grey's help to [[Mission to acquire a Jedi text|retrieve]] an ancient [[Jedi]] [[Unidentified Jedi text|text]] for the Jedi [[Rey Skywalker|Rey]]—which would have been key to her learning of the Force, including the [[Force healing]] [[Force power|ability]]. After bringing on Xiono to assist, the group would have traveled to a marooned [[Unidentified starship (Jedi text)|starship]] that was slowly being pulled into a [[Unidentified star (Jedi text)|star]] within a [[Unidentified nebula (Jedi text)|nebula]] that had the relic aboard. During the course of the mission, Xiono, Grey, and Kanata would have sought the artifact from the ship's vault, which was protected by various layers of traps. The First Order Raiders would have reappeared to find the relic, as well as other competing parties, including a [[Unidentified pirate group (Jedi text)|pirate group]], who wanted to acquire the book. though the two would have ultimately acquired the text, with Kanata later giving it to Rey. Melching had enjoyed writing the episode, finding it a unique opportunity to expand on Kanata's backstory, as she had limited screen time in the [[2015]] [[sequel trilogy]] film''[[Star Wars Year By Year: A Visual History, New Edition]]'' [[Star Wars: Episode VII The Force Awakens|''Star Wars'': Episode VII ''The Force Awakens'']].
